about: The freeze of the sweep where nobody is known: each file's SHA-256 as it stood before any job of it was stepped, held by test_unknown_frozen.py. A change is a new freeze, in its own commit, with its reason.
on_whose_word: the maintainer's, to the cloud session: "come up with the next few and run them"
against: the grown sweep as it came back from Kaggle with every signer enrolled: the branch shared-runs/door-kaggle-runs-k3, demo/shared-runs/door/grown/runs-k3

rules.U1: passes when every folder is whole by its seal and its signature holds, and no round's signer is in the ring
rules.U2: passes when every round held every folder it was given, as a signer the door has not enrolled
rules.U3: passes when every job was done and the share of steps saved is within 2 points of the share counted beforehand for a memory nobody trusts, 34.8
rules.U4: passes when every job ends as it did where every signer was enrolled: the same end, outcome and SHA-256, all 2200
rules.U5: passes when the checks stepped every kept state of all fifty folders again and found every one the same, and every halt the memory names halts

not_tested_is_not_passed: a folder that did not come back sealed leaves every rule not tested
not_frozen: the identities, which are made when the notebooks are and kept outside the repository; the Kaggle account
